verdict.rationale: An email provider could plausibly offer aliases or masked addresses, so this axis applies. The evidence documents no alias, masked-address, or forwarding feature that hides a user's real address. Creating many separate agent inboxes on demand and AgentID agent sign-in are adjacent features, not masking of the user's real address, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
